preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 10^5.
The value of K is between 1 and 10^5.
All characters in the string S are lowercase Latin characters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if not any(len(set(S[i:j+1])) == K for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S))) else max(len(S[i:j+1]) for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if len(set(S[i:j+1])) == K)
postconditions.description: The function returns the length of the longest substring with exactly K distinct characters. If no such substring exists, it returns -1.
